summary: The network-capable rerun crossed the predecessor's environment boundary and executed the existing served chat-canary Playwright suite against the current public route. GitHub Actions run 36773913946 attempt 2 / job 110623062291 reached the public page and durable thread successfully in desktop and narrow views, observed real thread fetches, preserved expected human+agent messages across reload, loaded ingress/input/progress APIs, preserved text on fail-closed send, showed the private-auth boundary, fabricated no queued state, had no page/console/request errors, no websockets/iframes, no horizontal overflow, and kept polling non-aggressive. The current served contract nevertheless fails three existing certification criteria in both views: composer_transport_false=false, submit_disabled=false, and agent_result_ref_traceable=false. The page simultaneously reports BOUNDARY_AUTH_REQUIRED · WORKSPACE_NOT_LINKED and 'NO ENVIADO · falta bridge privado · tu texto sigue en el composer', so the old transport/submit invariant no longer matches current behavior. This is a served contract regression/drift, not the prior runtime navigation boundary. No authenticated transport or worker liveness is claimed.

tests.name: network_capable_navigation
tests.detail: Both desktop 1365x900 and narrow 390x844 navigated with HTTP 200 and observed real thread responses with HTTP 200.

tests.name: initial_thread_and_reload
tests.detail: Expected current human and agent messages rendered in both views and remained present after reload.

tests.name: user_facing_modules
tests.detail: Composer visible; ingress, input and progress APIs loaded in both views.

tests.name: fail_closed_send_truth
tests.detail: Text was preserved; page showed AUTH_REQUIRED / WORKSPACE_NOT_LINKED and NO ENVIADO; no false queued state was emitted. However submit was not disabled and composer transport did not report false under the existing harness contract.

tests.name: result_ref_traceability
tests.detail: The expected current agent message rendered but its result_ref was not traceable under the existing harness in either view.

tests.name: responsive_layout
tests.detail: Narrow 390x844 had no horizontal overflow and retained the durable-thread/reload behavior.

tests.name: runtime_errors_and_public_transport_hygiene
tests.detail: No uncaught page errors, console errors, request failures, websockets, iframes or obvious public secret were observed; polling contract remained non-aggressive.
